variety: Argentine Spanish (Rioplatense). These day phrases are the same in Argentina and Mexico.
pronunciation_note: English-style respelling, capitals mark the stressed syllable. Argentine accent: "ll" and "y" sound like "sh".
topic: Time and days, part 2: days and plans

phrases.when: “Cuándo” means when. Swap in any plan: la clase, el partido.
“Mañana” is tomorrow. Say the ñ like “ny” in canyon. Days start with a small letter.
To say on which day, put “el” before it. Never “en”.

hook: Plan a day in Spanish. Three phrases.

quiz.prompt: The party is on Friday. What do you say?
